mandatory_distinctions: 17-letter native alphabet; ng is one velar-nasal unit, fakaua is a real glottal consonant.
Macron length must remain distinct from written double vowels.
Explicit acute mark on final vowel or followingword overrides default stress.
Default lexical stress is penultimate mora, not blindly penultimate written syllable.
Faufaua distinguishes definitive accent from enclitic stress, same written acute mark.
Single-mora clitics can shift the stress domain into adjacent words; grammar cannot be inferred from an isolated alphabet map.
uncertainties: PDFtext extraction represents macrons as grave-accented vowels: inspect actual rendered glyphs before treating that extraction artifact as normal written Tongan.
Diphthong/hiatus grouping and long-vowel splitting must be grounded in primary phonetic evidence.
Do not autoapply finalstress to every word after e/he: Faufaua contrasts explicit marked/unmarked forms.
No ordinary alphabet names may be replaced by phonetic examples. TePapa2016 page6 provides actual17letter names for future reviewed metadata.
No universalcarrier or source calibration yet; no ready-language claim.
